entry.title: New: Resolution 723 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO PŌHĀHĀ I KA LANI

Approves a grant of $114,900 to Pōhāhā I Ka Lani, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to reduce invasive species, propagate native plants, and educate users of the history and cultural significance of the Waipiʻo Valley Lookout, Hāmākua, property (Tax Map Key: 4-8-004:006), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.
